item.title: Voxel Raytracer Devlog
item.description: Interlude: performance 2026-07-31 This update does not contain any changes in vxray. The voxel ray tracing has stable performance now, but could it run better? The Metal profiler reveals the following story when rendering the same scene and view used previously in Naive DDA. In particular, the shader’s occupancy is rather low: FS occupancy counter: 35.43 % Register allocation: 92 Before 2-level DDA, these numbers were: FS occupancy counter: 71.39 % Register allocation: 42 The DDA shader became a lot larger due to the nested loops.
